Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AAPL.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $5.94 per share.
Revenue guidance of $33.3 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2019.
Our cloud segment grew 13% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Revenue guidance of $33.3 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 670 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 13% to 15% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
